qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Extensive manufacturing plant footprint and long-standing food service supply relationships provide customer proximity, but lack defensible barrier against rival converters. Unadjusted ROI of 9.5-10.9% falls short of the 12% ROIC hurdle. Fast-food chains and FMCG customers possess strong bargaining power, while single-use plastics regulations (EU SUP) drive recurring compliance and capex costs with limited pricing power.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (ROIC < 12% and lack of pricing power, REJECT). Finnish foodservice and flexible packaging converter is structurally constrained by powerful QSR and FMCG customer procurement, commodity resin/fiber price volatility, and tightening single-use plastics regulation, keeping multi-year returns on capital sub-hurdle (~9-10% ROI).
qualitative.evidence: Huhtamaki unadjusted ROI has hovered between 9.5% and 10.9% (2023-2025), failing the 12% ROIC hurdle. Operates as a contract packaging converter for concentrated buyers (e.g. McDonald's) with limited ability to pass through raw material cost spikes beyond standard contract lag. Facing structural regulatory headwinds from European single-use plastic restrictions.
